body: A Swiss Airbus A321-200, registration HB-IOO, operating flight LX-632 from Zurich to Paris Charles de Gaulle with 152 people on board, stopped its climb at FL240 due to a strange odour in the forward cabin and returned to Zurich, landing safely on runway 14 about 30 minutes after departure. The airline reported an extraordinary smell in the forward cabin that increasingly spread; the origin of the smell is currently unknown, and the passengers were rebooked onto other flights.

An Aerolineas Argentinas Embraer ERJ-190, registration LV-CEU, operating flight AR-1764 from Buenos Aires Aeroparque to Posadas, could not land due to weather and diverted to Rosario. En route the aircraft experienced electrical problems, possibly related to a lightning strike, and on approach to Rosario the crew did not receive a down and locked indication for the nose gear. A helicopter was dispatched to check the nose gear during a low approach and confirmed it was down; the aircraft landed safely on Rosario's runway 20 about 2:50 hours after departure.

An Airblue Airbus A321-200, registration AP-BMW, operating flight PA-201 from Islamabad to Karachi, was on approach to Karachi's runway 25R when a bird impacted the nose of the aircraft; it continued for a safe landing on runway 25R and was still on the ground in Karachi about 33 hours after landing. A Southwest Boeing 737-8 MAX, registration N8846Q, operating flight WN-712 from Louisville to Orlando with 172 people on board, stopped its climb at 6000 feet in heavy precipitation after the crew reported fumes in the cabin and cockpit; it returned to Louisville and landed safely on runway 17R about 20 minutes after departure. A replacement Boeing 737-8 MAX, registration N8923Q, reached Orlando with a delay of about 5 hours, while the occurrence aircraft remained on the ground for about 21 hours before positioning to Chicago Midway and resuming service.
en.summary: The Aviation Herald reported four incidents between November 4 and 6, 2026: a Swiss A321 returned to Zurich over a cabin odour, an Aerolineas Argentinas E190 had a nose-gear indication problem after suspected lightning trouble, an Airblue A321 suffered a bird strike on approach to Karachi, and a Southwest 737 MAX 8 returned to Louisville over fumes; all four aircraft landed safely.
en.title: Four aviation incidents in one roundup: Swiss A321 odour, Aerolineas E190 gear scare and more

body: 瑞士航空一架空中巴士A321-200（註冊編號HB-IOO）執行LX-632航班自蘇黎世飛往巴黎戴高樂，機上152人；航機自蘇黎世28跑道爬升途中，因前艙出現異味，於FL240停止爬升，約30分鐘後平安降落蘇黎世14跑道。航空公司表示，前艙出現異常氣味並逐漸擴散，氣味來源目前不明，乘客已改搭其他航班。
阿根廷航空一架Embraer ERJ-190（註冊編號LV-CEU）執行AR-1764航班自布宜諾斯艾利斯飛往波薩達斯，因天候無法降落，改飛羅薩里奧；途中航機出現電氣問題，可能與雷擊有關。進場羅薩里奧時，機組未收到鼻輪放下鎖定指示，派直升機於低空進場時目視檢查，確認鼻輪已放下，航機隨後平安降落羅薩里奧20跑道，起飛後約2小時50分鐘。

Airblue一架空中巴士A321-200（註冊編號AP-BMW）執行PA-201航班自伊斯蘭瑪巴德飛往喀拉蚩，進場喀拉蚩25R跑道時，飛鳥撞擊機鼻，航機繼續進場並平安降落25R跑道；落地約33小時後，航機仍停留在喀拉蚩。西南航空一架波音737MAX8（註冊編號N8846Q）執行WN-712航班自路易斯維爾飛往奧蘭多，機上172人；航機在大雨中自路易斯維爾17L跑道起飛爬升，於6,000英尺因機艙與駕駛艙出現煙霧氣味停止爬升，折返路易斯維爾，約20分鐘後平安降落17R跑道。替代航機波音737MAX8（註冊編號N8923Q）延誤約5小時抵達奧蘭多；事發航機在地面停留約21小時後，調機飛往芝加哥中途機場，恢復營運。
zh.summary: 11月4日至6日，The Aviation Herald通報4起航空事件：瑞士航空A321因前艙異味折返蘇黎世、阿根廷航空E190疑似雷擊後起落架指示異常、Airblue A321進場時遭鳥擊，以及西南航空737MAX8因機艙異味折返路易斯維爾；4架航機均平安降落。
zh.title: 四起航空事件彙整：瑞航A321機艙異味折返、阿根廷E190起落架異常
